hero.headline: Get your money in order. No bank in the middle.
hero.subheadline: Each card with its own billing cycle, import from Cal and Max in seconds, everything in one place.
hero.privacyTooltip: Your data is encrypted. We never connect to your bank — you import your own CSV files — and we never share your information with third parties.

billingCycle.title: Per-card billing cycle
billingCycle.caption: Every card, with its own day

howItWorks.sectionTitle: Like Excel, just easier to keep up with
howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: Excel works, but let’s be honest, no one really enjoys using it. Lyra gives you the same control, in a way that’s simpler to stick with.

step1.title: Add a transaction in seconds
step1.description: Enter an amount and category, and you're done. Everything else is already set up.

step2.title: Everything is ready to go
step2.description: Accounts, categories, and payment methods are already there. Change anything whenever you want.

step3.title: See the full picture instantly
step3.description: Your dashboard updates right away, what came in, what went out, and where your money is going.

features.sectionSubtitle: For people who want to understand their money, not manage another system.

dashboard.title: Clear dashboard
dashboard.description: See your month at a glance, income, expenses, and where your money is going.

transactions.title: Transaction tracking
transactions.description: Quickly add income and expenses. Filter by date, category, or account.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Organize your money in a way that matches how you actually think about it.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Track multiple accounts, bank, cash, or anything else.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.description: Not just how much you paid, but how you paid.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set a budget for each category and see in real time if you’re staying on track.

bottomCta.title: Still using Excel?
bottomCta.subtitle: There’s a much easier way to understand where your money goes.
bottomCta.feature1: Works in web and mobile, no install needed
bottomCta.feature2: No payment or credit card required
bottomCta.feature3: Your data is safe and secure
